snippet.title: Guardian Chicken | Tower Defense Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734000/Guardian_Chicken/

I've been working on this small tower defense game for the past 3 months. You play as a tiny chicken defending the barn from waves of zombie animals.

You can wishlist the game if it looks interesting to you :)

Credits:
- Game Development: Written in C using raylib
- Music: Background music by Aila Scott (not affiliated, source: https://ailascott.itch.io/free-music-pack-lo-fi-indie-metal-orchestral)
- Font: Kitchen Sink (source: https://polyducks.itch.io/kitchen-sink-textmode-font)
